name: [UPD] Nights of Eternity 🍕
desc:
"This night is gonna be an eternity"
"Say that again...."

As a survivor complete arcades, protect your team, and fend off the animatronics. Survive until the night ends. 
Animatronics will hunt down every survivor until none are left standing, while survivors will help each other survive the night. 

Credits: 1aple (Music), VibaPop (Models)
